title: Kasdan Co. — Brand & Social
summary: The café we run, and the TikTok channel we make for it every week.
overview: Kasdan Co. is our own café in Sault Ste. Marie. We plan, shoot, edit and post its short-form content ourselves, and the channel has passed one million cumulative views on TikTok.

cover.alt: Dan O'Brien and Kass outside the Kasdan Co. storefront

idea.heading: How we run it
body: We plan, shoot, edit and post for the café every week, mostly around what's happening at the counter — new drinks, seasonal donuts, regulars and the occasional stunt.
One of those stunts became a Guinness World Record: on 27 October 2024, Daniel O'Brien and Kassandra Yee stacked ten doughnuts in one minute, the tallest stack by a team of two.

execution.heading: Why it matters for clients
body: It's the same weekly routine we offer the businesses we work with.

awards.name: Guinness World Record — tallest stack of doughnuts in one minute (team of two)
